gloss: to make sense; to be logical; to be consistent

definitions.gloss: to make sense; to be logical; to be consistent; to be coherent
definitions.explanation: For an argument, explanation, or course of action to follow a clear, logical thread from beginning to end.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べて→述べる：02389_noberu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主張|しゅちょう}→主張：03220_shuchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{反論|はんろん}→反論：08677_hanron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧しよう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: His argument was consistent from start to finish, and there was no way to refute it.

notes:
{筋|すじ}が{通|とお}る uses ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ in the sense of "logic" or "reasoning" (like a thread running through something) and ⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (to pass through). The image is of a logical thread running cleanly through an argument.

The negative form {筋|すじ}が{通|とお}らない means "to not make sense" or "to be illogical."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧ (makes sense — て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form is most common)
- ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}っ→通る：01243_tooru⟧た〜 (a logical/coherent... — used as a modifier)
- {筋|すじ}が{通|とお}らない (doesn't make sense)
